name: Turn Guard
description: Publishes an agent's finished briefs to a host folder, and can make listed agents answer one turn at a time.

briefsDir.label: Briefs folder
briefsDir.help: Absolute host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing.

publishedPathPrefix.label: Published path prefix
publishedPathPrefix.help: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path.

queue.label: One-at-a-time agents
queue.help: Agents whose inbound turns run one at a time; the rest wait their turn.

briefsDir.description: Absolute host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing. No default. A relative path leaves publish_brief unregistered.

publishedPathPrefix.description: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path. Unset: the host path is returned.

maxBriefChars.description: Longest brief publish_brief accepts, in characters.

queue.description: Makes listed agents answer one inbound turn at a time. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess for agent_end.

agents.description: Agent ids that answer one turn at a time. Empty or unset: nothing is queued.

maxWaitMs.description: Longest a turn waits for its agent, in milliseconds. Past it the sender gets busyText. OpenClaw aborts an inbound message not adopted within 300000 ms.

maxWaiting.description: Most turns waiting per agent. A turn arriving at a full line gets busyText at once.

maxHoldMs.description: A turn that never reports its end frees the agent after this long, in milliseconds.

restMs.description: Pause before the next waiting turn while the agent has been busy, in milliseconds.

busyShare.description: The agent counts as busy when its turns filled more than this share of busyWindowMs. 1 turns the rest off.

busyWindowMs.description: Window busyShare is measured over, in milliseconds.

busyText.description: Reply to a turn that is not queued or waited too long.
